subject: Onprem platform fee & support slab question
content:
--- Message 1 (2027-04-01 09:15:00 -0700) ---
From: Tanya Singh <tanya@cormed.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cormed.io
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify onprem platform fee amortization & support slabs

Hi Sofia / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. A few procurement questions came up after the internal review — can you help with concrete language and a short example we can attach to our SOW?

High level asks:
- We need a clear definition of the platform fee for on‑prem/VPC: is it a one‑time license, an amortized platform fee, or a combination with a monthly ops retainer?
- If amortized, please show a 3‑year amortization example (12/24/36 months) with how the fee is presented on invoices.
- Clarify support tiers (response times, oncall vs business hours, and whether they’re included in the platform fee or billed separately).
- Any one‑time migration or onboarding credits you can offer for a pilot that converts to a 24‑month commit?

Attachments: we will share our expected MAUs and peak throughput in cor_med_mau_estimates.csv today — that will inform node sizing.

Appreciate a short summary we can pass to procurement/legal.

Best,
Tanya Singh
VP Operations, CorMed Health
Procurement: procurement@cormed.io

--- Message 2 (2027-04-01 13:40:22 -0700) ---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Singh <tanya@cormed.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 13:40:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify onprem platform fee amortization & support slabs

Hi Tanya — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary below; I’ve attached a one‑page pricing summary and a stubbed MAU file (we’ll match sizing to your csv once received).

Short answers up front:
- Platform fee: combination model. We offer a one‑time deployment license that customers can amortize over any term for accounting purposes, plus an optional ongoing platform ops retainer for managed control‑plane and break/fix. The one‑time license can be amortized but is invoiced once (or split into installments on request).
- Support tiers: three tiers (Standard, Priority, Enterprise). Standard is business hours (M–F 9–5) with 8–24 hour response; Priority includes 24x7 monitoring and 4‑hour P1; Enterprise adds a named SRE + quarterly runbooks and 1‑hour P1 response. Support can be included in a bundled package or line‑itemed as an ops retainer.
- Migration/onboarding credits: we can offer a one‑time onboarding credit up to 10% of the license value for pilots that convert to a 24‑month minimum commit (subject to case size).

Example amortization (illustrative):
- One‑time license: $360,000
- If amortized over 36 months = $10,000/mo (license amortization) on your internal P&L; invoiced as a single line for accounting but we can present an optional monthly amortization schedule.
- Ops retainer (optional): Standard $8k/mo; Priority $20k/mo; Enterprise $45k/mo (includes dedicated SRE hours).

Packaging options we recommend to procure:
- Anchor + Metered: small license + metered node consumption (best for pilots or variable usage).
- Reserved Node Bundle: larger upfront license with discounted per‑node rates and included Priority support.

Attachments: Redwood-Private-pricing-summary.pdf (1p), cor_med_mau_estimates_template.csv (stub).

Would you like a worked quote using the numbers from your csv? If yes, please send the file and indicate preferred amortization term (12/24/36).

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com

--- Message 3 (2027-04-02 10:05:10 -0700) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tanya Singh <tanya@cormed.io>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify onprem platform fee amortization & support slabs

Thanks Tanya / Sofia — I pulled together two explicit packaging examples so procurement has numbers to review. I’ll mark these as illustrative and will convert to a formal quote once we get your MAU csv.

Option A — Anchor + Metered (pilot → scale)
- Anchor license: $75,000 one‑time (recommended small anchor for pilot).
- Metered nodes: $0.80 per inference‑hour (billed monthly).
- Support: Standard included for first 90 days; Priority can be added at $18k/mo after pilot conversion.
- Migration credit: one‑time $7,500 (10% of anchor) if you sign 24 months within 90 days of pilot close.

Option B — Reserved Node Bundle (enterprise anchor)
- License: $300,000 one‑time (covers entitlement for up to 16 reserved nodes).
- Included: Priority support for 12 months (4‑hour P1, named SRE hours — 20 hrs/mo).
- Per‑node overage: $1,200/node/mo if you exceed reserved capacity.
- Volume discount: 12% off license if you commit to annual prepay for year 1 (reduces effective license amortization).

Procurement checklist items we can provide immediately:
- Draft SOW (link in related_links) + redlineable terms
- SOC 2 evidence package and security addendum
- Example invoice layout showing one‑time license + optional monthly ops retainer

I’m attaching a quick draft MAP (MAP_draft.docx) with dates for pilot, runbook handover, and conversion milestone (to trigger the migration credit). If it helps, Ben can run a scenario with corner‑case infra (multi‑region/air‑gapped) and give a delta.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Principal, Solutions & Commercials — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

--- Message 4 (2027-04-05 16:22:00 -0700) ---
From: Tanya Singh <tanya@cormed.io>

Cc: procurement@cormed.io
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify onprem platform fee amortization & support slabs

Hi Sofia / Marissa — apologies for the delay, procurement ran the numbers and the leadership team liked Option B (Reserved Node Bundle) as the preferred path to reduce operational variability. A few follow ups before we hand to Legal: 

1) We accept the structure in principle — please prepare a formal quote and SOW reflecting: $300k license, Priority support included for 12 months, 16 reserved nodes entitlement, per‑node overage $1,200/node/mo.

2) Migration/onboarding credit: we request the previously described one‑time credit be 10% of license value ($30k) rather than 7.5k — this is conditional on signing a 24‑month commitment within 60 days of pilot finish. Can Redwood confirm?

3) Invoicing: procurement prefers license split into two installments (50% upon SOW signature, 50% at 60 days after signature) — will Redwood accept installment billing? If so please show this as an option on the quote.

4) SOW redlines: I uploaded a first pass to the Drive folder (link above) and placed comments on the billing schedule and IP/escrow clauses.

If you can get a formal quote + redlined SOW back by EOD Wednesday we can route to Legal and Finance quickly.

Thanks,
Tanya Singh
VP Operations, CorMed Health
procurement@cormed.io
